# langsmith_optimization_job_logs (Data Source)

Reads the log stream of a prompt optimization job — progress messages, results and errors as the job runs.

This is a snapshot taken when Terraform reads the data source, not a live tail: a job still running will report more later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_optimization_job_logs" "example" {
  owner  = langsmith_optimization_job.example.owner
  repo   = langsmith_optimization_job.example.repo
  job_id = langsmith_optimization_job.example.id
}

output "optimization_errors" {
  value = [
    for l in data.langsmith_optimization_job_logs.example.logs : l.message
    if l.log_type == "error"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `job_id` (String) UUID of the optimization job.
- `owner` (String) Owner of the hub repo (`-` for the current workspace).
- `repo` (String) Handle of the hub repo.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `logs` (Attributes List) The job's log entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the entry was written.
- `data` (String) JSON-encoded structured payload attached to the entry, when present.
- `id` (String) UUID of the log entry.
- `log_type` (String) Entry type: `info`, `result`, `error` or `link`.
- `message` (String) Log message.
